FAQ

Common questions

What tools do you use for AI automation? ▾
We work with Make (Integromat), Zapier, n8n, OpenAI, HubSpot, and custom API integrations — whatever fits your existing stack best.
Do I need to replace my current software? ▾
Usually not. We connect your existing tools together — CRM, email platform, calendar, social — into smarter, automated workflows.
What’s the most common automation we build? ▾
Lead qualification and follow-up sequences. Most businesses lose deals because follow-up is inconsistent. AI automation fixes that permanently.
How long does it take to build? ▾
Simple automations (lead routing, follow-up sequences) go live in 48–72 hours. Complex multi-tool workflows take 1–2 weeks.
What if I’m not technical? ▾
You don’t need to be. We design, build, test, and maintain everything. You approve the logic before it goes live and we’re available if anything needs adjusting.
